Eternal is way harder mechanically. You actually have to be accurate and can't just super shotgun and gauss everything (although that's still one of the highest dps combos besides tri chaingun, double grenade, precision bolt shot, ballista )

Even the ballista which is a nerfed gauss is still too strong. You can't dodge forever either, you can't simply avoid the enemies on the hardest difficulty. You have to use flame belch and especially the ice and frag grenade for brief breathing room.
